question: Which of Tay Roc's battles is the greatest of his career?

stances.marcus-blaze: The battle against Hollow Da Don is the undisputed peak, defined by the legendary 'Seatbelt' bar and his coronation as the face of the URL.
stances.tasha-raw: While Hollow Da Don was huge, Tay Roc's longevity and consistent impact, especially post-2021, show his greatest battle is yet to be fully defined.
stances.king-knowledge: The Ill Will battle, particularly the second round with the 'Emmett Till' scheme, represents a higher level of lyrical skill and a more definitive performance than Hollow.

withheld.instruction: There is no single consensus on which of Tay Roc's battles is the greatest of his career.

protected_facts.note: Tay Roc's real name is Donte Richardson.
banned_phrasings: Tay Roc, also known as Donte Richardson

waypoints.note: Marcus, you're calling Hollow the undisputed peak, but isn't that ignoring his entire career arc?
Tasha, you're talking about longevity, but what about the singular moments of brilliance that define greatness?
King Knowledge, you bring up Ill Will, but does that battle have the same cultural impact as Hollow?
King Knowledge, you mentioned the 'Emmett Till' scheme, but the 'Seatbelt' bar from Hollow is what truly cemented him.
Marcus, you cite Hollow solidifying him as 'the face of the URL,' but wasn't that more of a culmination than a singular event?

detonation_react.instruction: Wait, so you're saying there's no consensus? That feels like a cop-out.

kk_drop.instruction: Take the floor for your ONE weight-drop: name the thing the others have been circling without seeing. Two or three sentences, NEW words only, unhurried, air around it. End by reframing the question itself.

opener.instruction: Tay Roc has battled for nearly 20 years, but one battle stands above all others.

exit.instruction: We've debated the peak moments and the long game, but the true measure of greatness is always up for discussion.
